'''Jewelsnail''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Gemsnail]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Crystalsnail]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "The wind is unusually loud today... Oh! That's a Zobo charging at us! Still a bit far off, though, all's good. Jewelsnail might be slow, but those crystal shards sure aren't."

Jewelsnail is a red rarity Tatari that deals AoE damage while walling enemies with a unique summon.

== Appearance ==
Jewelsnail's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form recolors the purple amethyst and accents on its shell into an emerald green color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Jewelsnail's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Crystalsnail]], you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Raise this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Events#Treasure Hunt|Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 120 treasure) or Cozy Farm (use x7200 fertilizer).
* Obtain 50 more Tatari Wishboxes.
